entry.name: grilling
entry.description: A questioning layer that surfaces load-bearing design decisions only the user's brain can answer. Enhances planning workflows (spec-driven development, plan mode, ticket drafting, free-form design conversations) by injecting harder questions with genuine recommendations, and gates implementation behind user confirmation.

dependents.name: bug-investigator
dependents.description: Investigate sparse Jira bug tickets and enrich them with a grounded root-cause theory. Fetch the ticket, trace code across repos (starting from any linked PRs the triager found), form a falsifiable theory, and append to Dev Notes or return a draft. Triggers on "investigate this", "look at this bug", "trace down this bug", or pasting a Jira bug key/URL.

dependents.name: bug-triager
dependents.description: Triage a Jira bug by searching Jira for related, duplicate, or previously-fixed tickets before code investigation. Ranks matches, captures their linked pull requests, optionally posts a related-tickets comment, and hands off to bug-investigator. Triggers on "triage this", "has this been reported", "find related tickets", "check for duplicates".

dependents.name: triage-bug
dependents.description: Interactive bug-triage → investigation workflow as a pi prompt template. Invoke as `/triage-bug <TICKET-KEY>`. Asks before any Jira write. Enforces strict triage→investigate handoff via triage-context.json. Headless counterpart lives at my-engineering-library/workflows/bug-triage/.
